scope: Generation-tagged asynchronous Metal worker-frame failure callback
behavior: Both worker presentation paths capture submitting worker generation.
Command-buffer failures use the scoped callback when installed. Existing clients retain the global callback fallback.
Metal command allocation and device failures remain global.
limitations: API compiled with prior committed PCMode. Pending PCMode recovery wiring and stale callback lifecycle qualification are not proven by this build.
No physical renderer reset or guest GPU acceleration completion claim.
